shapeFindings.interpretation: No product/resource/target platform contract exists. Descriptions, URLs, desktop productType, environment requirements and officialDownload are not proof of native Windows/macOS/Linux support. resource.lastVerifiedAt is resource provenance time, not platform evidence time.
currentHiddenAssumptions: desktop productType is treated as Windows-oriented by existing client flows
environment requirements such as python/docker/wsl are not native OS support
resource-link targets are shown without host-platform intersection

productOrResourceSupportRecord.architectures: unique architectureIds; empty means unknown, not universal

evidence.url: HTTPS first-party or approved official/community channel

productOrResourceSupportRecord.note: Do not infer native support from a web page, Electron, Python package or browser/remote endpoint. A record without evidence remains unknown/blocked.

targetIntersection.unknownPolicy: hide or render unsupported; never fall back to execution

minimalExtensibleContractCandidate.hostPlatformBoundary: Windows fixed profiles and managed actions cannot imply macOS/Linux support. Each platform requires independent profile, artifact, lifecycle and receipt review.
minimalExtensibleContractCandidate.taxonomyBoundary: Keep the existing 21 scenario/canonical tags and four resource-store semantics unchanged; platform/runtime is orthogonal metadata, not a new product category.

projectionAndBrokerSeam.catalogProjection: Add a pure platform intersection projection beside existing resourceTargetsByType; do not copy resources or targets per OS.
projectionAndBrokerSeam.agentCapabilityBroker: Broker must require the same platform intersection before catalogBinding/localStatus/grantFor; a valid host/profile alone is insufficient.
projectionAndBrokerSeam.currentGap: shared/agent-capability-broker.cjs filters hostProductId and installProfileId but has no requested platform or runtime input.
projectionAndBrokerSeam.resourceGap: shared/ecosystem-resources.cjs validates resource/target identity and modules but has no platform availability field.
